dns_leak_protection.title: DNS leak protection
dns_leak_protection.desc: Blocks Windows' parallel DNS queries from escaping via the LAN adapter. Protects against ISP DNS hijacking (Rostelecom, MSK-IX, etc.). On Windows, changing system DNS requires administrator privileges. Disable only if it interferes with local-network workflows.

adblock.title: Ad Blocker
adblock.desc: Blocks ad and tracker domains in VPN traffic (sing-box). Works without installing a certificate. On-page banners and in-video YouTube ads need HTTPS filtering (currently disabled for stability).
